rationale:
The reviewed tests cover the obligations in `requirements.sdk.graph.fingerprint`.

- **Freshness compares both fields as opaque values.** The test is `crates/trust-but-verify/src/graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[wildcard_versions_still_check_inputs_and_errors]`. It uses `Fingerprint::new` and runs `is_current` in three cases. A matching scheme and value is current. A different scheme with the same value (`other`/`same` against `fp("same")`) is not current. A different value (`changed`) is not current. Together these check that scheme and value are each compared.
- **`Fingerprint::new(scheme, value)` and the public fields.** The same test constructs a fingerprint with `new`. The storage test, `crates/trust-but-verify/tests/storage.rs#fn[records_round_trip_and_malformed_or_incompatible_data_is_an_error]`, builds `Fingerprint::new("targets-v1", "preserved")`.
- **Trait implementations.**
  - `Serialize` and `Deserialize`: the storage test stores a record whose dependencies hold a `Fingerprint`, reloads it, and asserts `loaded.dependencies == labeled.dependencies`. That round trip preserves both fields.
  - `PartialEq` and `Eq`: the dependency comparisons in that test and the freshness comparisons use equality on `Fingerprint`.
  - `Debug`: `assert_eq!` on `Dependency` values compiles only if `Debug` is implemented.
  - `Clone`: `saved.version.clone()` in the storage test and the cloning of dependencies in the validation paths exercise cloning.
  - All of these are plain `#[derive(...)]` implementations with no conditionals of their own.
- **Exported shape.** `crates/trust-but-verify/tests/public_api.rs#fn[public_exports_match_the_appendix]` checks the export inventory against the rustdoc output.
- **Not directly tested.** `#[non_exhaustive]` is a compile-time attribute with no runtime behavior. I read that the implementation applies it at `crates/trust-but-verify/src/graph.rs#struct[Fingerprint]`. I did not find a test for it and count that as no gap.

text: `Fingerprint` pairs a digest with the scheme used to compute it. Each `NodeContents`
implementation chooses the scheme. Freshness checks compare both fields as opaque values.
pub fn new(scheme: String, value: String) -> Self;
